input.answer: I never got my own numbers: the "עצמאים" button wouldn't switch, so all the calculator showed was the employee example (₪300 a month from me + ₪900 from an employer). That gives "52,334" kept after 4 years (with "המסלקח −10,661" tax) and "137,649" after 8 years (tax 0). Most of that is employer money I won't have as self-employed, so I can't use those figures.

stuck.why: I tapped 'עצמאים' 4 times, by name and by position, and after scrolling so the top bar wasn't over it. It stayed on 'שכירים' with the checkmark. Without it I can't get a self-employed calculation.
They ask for 'הפקדת המעסיק, מהשכר' and 'משכורת ברוטו'. As self-employed I don't know what to put there, and with the toggle stuck I couldn't see what fields self-employed people would get.

Labels 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' / 'מ־6 שנים: פטור ממס'
skimmed: Top heading and subheading, 'מה זה' paragraph (6 years tax free)
skipped: Rest of the page below the bar chart
Input fields (salary, %, return, fees). I left them as they were
unsure_meaning: Whether the 52,334 at 4 years is after tax (there's a −10,661 and a pink striped box)
Dotted underlines on the numbers, and '123 מחושב' vs '123 ממקור' at the top
not_found: A working self-employed version of the calculator
